verification_summary.balance_notes: Race washington-county-commissioner-d4. Sinclair has 3 bio and 7 positions (4 T1, 1 T2, 2 T3). Callaway has 4 bio and 8 positions (5 T1, 3 T3). Coverage is comparable. Sinclair has no questionnaire item because she did not answer OPB's questionnaire, which is documented. Spot-search found Banks Post candidacy articles for both ('kipperlyn-sinclair-seeks-washington-county-district-4-seat', 'steve-callaway-seeks-washington-county-district-4-seat') and OPB 2026-05-08 '9 newcomers vie for 2 seats'. None was used for either candidate, so the omission is equal. File-level: name matches pamphlet/official listing. Incumbent false confirmed: BCC page lists 'Vice Chair and District 4 Commissioner Jerry Willey'. Website https://electstevecallaway.com confirmed as printed in the 2026 county pamphlet.
